ayahOccurrences.text: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ

lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: فَٱعْتِلُوهُ is in the derivative form: اُعْتُلْ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ت/ل   ʿ–t–l crowbar; to drag violently; ruffian and cruel person.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
إعْتِلوه ʾiʿtilūhu and عُتُلّ ʿutull.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
اُعْتُلْ /اعْتِلْ ʾuʿtul/ʾiʿtil [imper. V., trans.] drag and cast away violently

(44:47) خُذُوهُ‏ ‏فَاعْتِلُوهُ‏ ‏إِلَى‏ ‏سَوَاءِ‏ ‏الْجَحِيمِ‏ take him and thrust him into the midst of Hell.

entries.label: عُتُلٌّ
entries.definitionHtml:
عُتُلٌّ ʿutull [quasi‐act. part.] ruffian, ignoble, coarse, rude, rough

(68:12–13) مَنَّاعٍ‏ ‏لِلْخَيْرِ‏ ‏مُعْتَدٍ‏ ‏أَثِيمٍ عُتُلٍّ‏ ‏بَعْدَ‏ ‏ذَلِكَ‏ ‏زَنِيمٍ‏ hinderer of good, aggressor, sinful, and above all an infamous ruffian.
